item.title: CVE-2026-126675 · 7.3 HIGH — Nitro PDF Pro: Incorrect default permissions allow local privilege escalation
item.description: Incorrect default permissions in Nitro PDF Pro before 26.4 on Windows allow a local low-privileged user to execute code in the context of another user who launches the application.
